Snug icon concepts

A snug is the small private room in a British pub. Each concept follows the Negroni glyph: chunky round-ended strokes, a container with something inside it, and the four-pointed sparkle.

Round 2: doors

5. The snug door, half-glazed

A square-topped door on its threshold, with a glass pane carrying the s, as pub snug doors carried their name etched in the glass. A knob makes it a door at any size.

SnugFernlea Robotics

6. The snug door, locked

The same door with the knob replaced by a keyhole: a room of your own, and it locks.

SnugFernlea Robotics

7. The page in the door

The pane becomes a dog-eared page and the lock a keyhole, so the door says documents and privacy without a letter.

SnugFernlea Robotics

8. The door that is a page

The door itself has a folded top corner, so it reads as both a door and a document, with a keyhole where the handle would be.

SnugFernlea Robotics
